relation.description: Source identity relation for the vulnerability-relevant value.

nodes.description: First project-code read on the vulnerable path. `check_buffer` reads the first byte of the attacker-controlled buffer into `ch`, creating the record-tag state that decides whether the OMF parser continues.

`check_buffer` dereferences the OMF header's two-byte size field from `buf + 1` without first rejecting buffers shorter than the 4-byte header. The later size predicate is below this dereference, so it cannot protect truncated inputs. The patch fixes this exact obligation by switching to bounded `r_buf_read_le16_at()` / `r_buf_read_at()` helpers and querying the buffer size explicitly.

ASan sink. `ut8p_bw(buf + 1)` performs the first out-of-bounds read from the 1-byte heap buffer returned by `r_buf_data()`, producing the observed heap-buffer-overflow READ of size 1 at `libr/bin/p/bin_omf.c:37`.

edges.description: The exact heap-buffer base pointer materialized by `r_buf_data (b, &length)` is reused unchanged as the base of the raw `ut8p_bw (buf + 1)` header read.
edges.evidence: In the vulnerable original case, `whole_buf_state.buf_ptr == header_use.buf_ptr`.
